answer: The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in basalt, expire in atlas, and jetty lists each expiry. An attacker running 167 aliases thus needs 183 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1575 identities would post 1072 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
